chars.ILYAS: ILYAS: an 18-year-old Moroccan young man, slim, short curly black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers, white sneakers and a grey backpack
chars.NEIGHBOR: NEIGHBOR: a Moroccan man in his late 50s, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, round glasses, wearing a beige knitted cardigan over a white shirt, brown trousers and leather slippers
chars.MANAL: MANAL: an 18-year-old Moroccan young woman, long dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a light-blue denim jacket, white t-shirt, black jeans and a canvas tote bag
chars.CONCIERGE: CONCIERGE: a chubby Moroccan man in his 40s with a black moustache, wearing a dark-blue security guard jacket and a navy cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the stairwell of a modern apartment building in Agadir. ILYAS, leaving for school, is stopped on the stairs by NEIGHBOR, who stands in his way with a raised hand and a serious, knowing look. ILYAS freezes mid-step, surprised and uneasy. Both in the center of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, building entrance hall in Agadir with mailboxes. NEIGHBOR warmly greets ILYAS with a big friendly smile and a hand on his shoulder, ILYAS smiles back politely. Cheerful, kind atmosphere.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell landing. NEIGHBOR leans close to ILYAS and speaks quietly with a fatherly but grave expression, one finger raised as if giving advice. ILYAS listens, eyebrows raised, nervous.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Evening in the apartment building stairwell. MANAL climbs the stairs toward a door on the upper landing, smiling. Behind her, two apartment doors are slightly open and curious older neighbours (a woman in a headscarf and an old man) peek out through the gaps, staring at her suspiciously.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Building lobby. A group of three older neighbours (a woman in a house djellaba and headscarf, an old man in a grey djellaba, a woman with curlers) crowd around CONCIERGE at his small desk, gesturing angrily upward toward the stairs, complaining. CONCIERGE nods and writes in a notebook.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell. NEIGHBOR, stern now, points his finger at ILYAS's chest in warning. ILYAS steps back against the wall, shocked, mouth open.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell. NEIGHBOR holds up his mobile phone as if ready to call the police, his face firm. ILYAS stares at the phone in panic, both hands raised, eyes wide.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Stairwell seen from above. NEIGHBOR calmly walks down the stairs, hands behind his back, without looking back. ILYAS stands frozen on the landing above, staring after him, speechless.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS alone on the stairwell landing, face flushed red with embarrassment, both hands on his head, eyes wide with worry, comic awkward expression, school backpack sliding off his shoulder.
